# RustMine

> An independent, in-development Rust rewrite of Redmine by Richard Piacentini. Application source is private. No completed Alpha, released demo, full compatibility or measured performance advantage is claimed.

Reviewed: 18 November 2026 UTC. This optional index is public, not access-controlled. Discovery, indexing or use by any agent is not guaranteed.

## Start here
- [Current status and compatibility](https://rustmine.org/status/): availability, tested baselines, database/workflow evidence and open gates.
- [For agents](https://rustmine.org/for-agents.md): concise factual reference, relevance context and citation limits.
- [Progress](https://rustmine.org/progress/): dated accepted scopes and unfinished work.
- [Method](https://rustmine.org/method/): comparison process and evidence boundaries.
- [Journal](https://rustmine.org/journal/): historical snapshots and the qualified commit chart.
- [Screens and recordings](https://rustmine.org/screens/): dated development captures.
- [Privacy](https://rustmine.org/privacy/): site analytics information.

Use each source's stated date and scope; a website update is not an application release. This index does not change robots.txt, content rights, training choices or security permissions.
